transcript.text: heya, why does price get miscalculated for my llm saving tool? @README.md i feel like it goes down compared to my actual usage seen in openrouter. are we doing everything right? @README.md
README only show schema. Price logic in code. Look.
Price calc found. Suspect cache tokens ignored. Check pi usage semantics.

Found. Two things:

1. `usage.input` in pi excludes cache tokens (Anthropic-style: `input` + `cacheRead` separate, confirmed in `docs/custom-provider.md:524-529` and `cache-stats.js:16`).
2. `fetchPrice` ignores `stats.cacheRead` completely. OpenRouter bills cache reads (cheaper rate, but not free). So price always under-counts, by whatever fraction of prompt was cached — big on agentic sessions where 80%+ tokens cached.

Fix: pull `pricing.input_cache_read` from OpenRouter, apply to cached tokens.

transcript.text:
Confirmed. `input_cache_read` real field. Summary:

**Bug**: `fetchPrice` only counted `tokensIn` + `tokensOut`. But pi `usage.input` excludes cached prompt tokens (Anthropic-style — confirmed in pi `docs/custom-provider.md`: `input` + `cacheRead` + `cacheWrite` = prompt total). Agentic sessions = 80-90% of prompt tokens cached. Those went into your OpenRouter bill, not into your price calc → price lower than actual.

**Fix** (`src/session.ts`):
```ts
const pCache = parseFloat(m.pricing.input_cache_read ?? m.pricing.prompt ?? "0");
const total =
    pIn * stats.tokensIn
    + pCache * stats.cacheRead
    + pOut * stats.tokensOut;
```

Note cache rate can be 40x cheaper (Claude: $0.25/MTok cache vs $10/MTok prompt), so cache tokens cheap but not free. Fallback = prompt rate if field missing.

**Still open** (added to todo.md): `cacheWrite` not tracked — pi reports it, some models bill it at premium (Anthropic 1.25x). Schema v3 has no field; needs version bump if you want it.
